text: 美日证实双方联合干预日元汇率 特朗普再提珍珠港 贝森特表示，美国财政部正密切关注局势，并将“毫不犹豫地参与进一步的联合干预”。
text_en: The U.S. and Japan confirmed joint intervention in the yen exchange rate; Trump again mentioned Pearl Harbor. Bessent stated that the U.S. Treasury is closely monitoring the situation and will 'not hesitate to participate in further joint intervention.'
